fields.label: Web Account
fields.description: The account that OWNS this domain. Ownership is per-account, never per-service — that is the whole point of this doctype.

fields.label: Domain Name
fields.description: Normalized bare hostname, lowercase, no scheme/path/port. Unique per web account.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: How the account came to hold it: we registered it, they brought it, or it is a free Murzak subdomain (root domain set by FREE_SUBDOMAIN_ROOT_DOMAIN).

fields.label: Attached To Service
fields.description: serviceId this domain currently points at, or blank. NOT a Link — services are child rows on Web Account.selected_services, not a doctype. Blank is a legitimate state: a domain can be owned and unattached.

fields.label: Source Doctype
fields.description: Which intake record produced this domain (Hosting Domain Purchase Request / Hosting External Domain Connection / Hosting Murzak Subdomain), so an admin can trace a domain back to its request.

fields.label: Verification Token
fields.description: For external domains: the TXT value the customer publishes to prove control.
